description: 从 Grafana 面板迁移并汉化，已转换为“我的面板”原生格式。来源：node-exporter-overview。

variables.name: cluster_id
variables.label: 集群
variables.query:
SELECT DISTINCT scope_id AS __value, 
CASE 
  WHEN c.name != '' THEN c.name
  ELSE scope_id
END AS __text
FROM data_scope 
LEFT JOIN clusters c ON scope_id  = c.id
WHERE type = 'cluster'

queries.legend: Apps - Memory 已使用 by user-space applications
PageTables - Memory 已使用 to map between virtual and physical memory addresses
SwapCache - Memory that keeps track of pages that have been fetched from swap but not yet been modified
Slab - Memory 已使用 by the kernel to cache data structures for its own use (caches like inode, dentry, etc)
Cache - Parked file data (file content) cache
Buffers - Block device (e.g. harddisk) cache
Unused - 可用 memory unassigned
Swap - Swap space 已使用
Hardware Corrupted - Amount of RAM that the kernel identified as corrupted / not working
